title: Binance says it has covered all of the $6.3B in cryptoassets stolen on October 29, using its profits and emergency funds to replace common and obscure tokens (Teresa Xie/Bloomberg)
summary: Teresa Xie / Bloomberg: Binance says it has covered all of the $6.3B in cryptoassets stolen on October 29, using its profits and emergency funds to replace common and obscure tokens — Binance said it has covered all of the $6.3 billion in cryptoassets pilfered from customers, marking a capstone to the largest cybertheft in history.
